resolution: Existing owners; no new item or R-number allocated. Selective reconstruction remains a bounded exploratory branch of R064, not a complete decoder qualification.

items.title: Authored/cached preview control
items.applicability: Authored PNG timings exclude preparation, transfer and storage. They motivate a baseline, not a replacement for the qualified bounded revisit cache.

items.title: Codec-specific reduced reconstruction and selective-kernel screen
items.applicability: Native JPEG scaling and modern-codec lowres probes extend screening. They do not supersede the existing quarter-resolution MJPEG/MPEG-2 quality failures. The H.264 residual kernel is not a complete decoder or a certified-error JPEG implementation.

items.title: Independent random-access source extraction
items.applicability: VP9 packet selection and H.264 coarse IDR extraction support a browser baseline follow-up. Coarse 2-second and exact 3.5-second outputs are different contracts; full-file decode is not the best optimized random-access baseline.

items.title: Accurate temporal refinement and dependency reuse
items.applicability: Context for exact refinement only; this package does not test pending-consumer GOP batching and does not replace the existing browser component result.

items.title: Progressive image refinement and independent preview delivery
items.applicability: Native progressive JPEG state reuse yields exact final pixels with extra total work. This does not overturn the existing browser compositor refinement/final-fidelity failure.
